title: Lifecycle and Effects
description: Learn about component lifecycle and the useEffect hook for side effects.
longDescription: useEffect is React's bridge between the component world and the imperative browser world. In this module you'll learn to fetch data, clean up subscriptions, build custom hooks, and handle error boundaries so your app stays robust under real-world conditions.
whatYouLearn: Run side effects at the right time using the dependency array
Clean up timers, subscriptions, and fetch requests to prevent memory leaks
Fetch and cache API data with proper loading and error handling
Extract reusable logic into custom hooks that follow the rules of hooks
Catch rendering errors gracefully using error boundaries
